note: Times are in seconds against the 12.00 s approved cut. Cues must not overlap - verify programmatically before rendering.

cues.text: Built to be worn, not stored.

style_rules: every caption sits on an opaque plate - never bare text over picture
measured H-glyph height at least the profile minimum AND at least 3% of frame height
relative-sRGB design-colour contrast at least4:1; inspect decoded text for compression effects
one line where possible, two maximum, never three
a cue is on screen for at least 1.2 s regardless of how short the text is
caption origin is computed from the safe rectangle, never a fixed offset
